# WB2 · Tổng quan · Bác sĩ

Group **WB · Vận hành: tổng quan, hôm nay, lịch** · state · Next.js: **built (U2)** (`/dashboard`) · account `doctor-mai`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#doctorHome`
- Operations pages are drawn by `crm-ui.js` (dashboard, today) and `operations-ui.js` (schedule and the booking dialogs); calculations live in `PemaCRM` and `PemaOps` (`operations-data.js`).
- `crm-ui.js › doctorHome()`: title "Không gian bác sĩ · <name>", three KPI buttons (`doctor-today`, `doctor-patients`, `doctor-followups`), table "Lịch khám của tôi". Own visits only (`PemaStaff.owns`).
- Inventory note: Doctor role: sidebar of 8 items; dashboard is doctorHome, not the owner dashboard.
- Page key `dashboard` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `doctor-mai`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"dashboard\"]"}; it must show "Doanh số của tôi".

## Business rules
- "Không bao gồm dashboard CSKH hoặc tài chính toàn phòng khám" (subtitle of "Lịch khám của tôi").

## Differences from the app design
- App B1/B2 are the doctor workspace in mobile shape; the web adds the link "Doanh số của tôi →" to finance.

## Gotchas
- The demo day is fixed: 2026-09-20 09:00 (`DAY` in `operations-data.js` and `crm-automation.js`). Dates before that day cannot be booked.

- Frames: 1440x900 (inventory: 1440x900); screen label `WB2 · Tổng quan · Bác sĩ`.
